analytical_conventions.agreement_groups: disjoint exhaustive partition (both / if_only / lof_only / neither) of the saved 1% flag pair; partition validated
analytical_conventions.fixed_threshold_policy: saved Phase 3 flags consumed exactly as supplied; the 1% rule is never recomputed or re-optimised
analytical_conventions.fraud_discovery_curve: ranking by descending anomaly_score under the shared tie-breaking policy; ground-truth labels used post hoc only

hypergeometric.null_model: independent uniform random selection: run_a's flags and run_b's flags are two independent uniform random subsets of the n observations; the upper-tail probability is the extremity of the observed overlap under THIS null only and does not establish that flagged observations are true anomalies
hypergeometric.parameterisation: P(X >= observed) with X ~ Hypergeometric(N=n, successes=run_a flags, draws=run_b flags), evaluated with scipy.stats.hypergeom.sf / logsf

analytical_conventions.jaccard: intersection over union of the saved Phase 3 1% flags; two empty selections defined as 1.0

multithreshold.k_rule: k = round(n * pct / 100), required to satisfy 1 <= k <= n
multithreshold.tie_breaking: descending anomaly_score; ties resolved by ascending position in the canonical Phase 4 evaluation dataset row order (first-stored row wins; stable sort)

analytical_conventions.score_orientation: anomaly_score from the Phase 4 evaluation dataset (higher = more anomalous); native_score never used for ranking
analytical_conventions.spearman: Pearson correlation of tie-corrected average ranks (scipy.stats.rankdata) between anomaly_score vectors; the identical cross-run row_id sequence is validated first
analytical_conventions.tie_breaking: descending anomaly_score; ties resolved by ascending position in the canonical Phase 4 evaluation dataset row order (first-stored row wins; stable sort)

bootstrap.resampling: class-stratified with replacement; positives and negatives resampled separately; prevalence preserved exactly per replicate
bootstrap.selection_caveat: Exploratory analysis: the highlighted runs (IF_003, IF_004, LOF_004 and the IF_003/LOF_004 pair) were selected after inspecting the label-informed Phase 4 evaluation results; comparisons involving them are post-hoc and must not be read as confirmatory.
bootstrap.threshold_policy: saved Phase 3 flags consumed as supplied on every replicate (attached to the resampled observations); the 1% threshold is never reselected, re-optimised or recomputed inside replicates -- deliberately distinct from an optional top-1%-reselected bootstrap, which is NOT performed

model_fitting.note: Phase 5A is an analysis-only layer: no detector was constructed, fitted or refitted; Phase 4 scores and flags were consumed exactly as stored; no threshold was reselected and no plot was produced.

selection_caveat: Exploratory analysis: the highlighted runs (IF_003, IF_004, LOF_004 and the IF_003/LOF_004 pair) were selected after inspecting the label-informed Phase 4 evaluation results; comparisons involving them are post-hoc and must not be read as confirmatory.
